purpose: Executable denominator for unit conventions, dimensional analysis, natural-unit settings, and dimensional-invariance claims.

unit_convention_rows.unit_or_dimension_object: Unit system, natural-unit convention, dimensional matrix, dimensional-analysis basis, coordinate/quantity convention, or metadata-only unit wrapper invoked by FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
unit_convention_rows.dimensional_invariance_test: Declare base quantities, derived dimensions, dimensionless groups, unit definitions, natural-unit settings, conversion factors, and which statements survive arbitrary rescaling of units.
unit_convention_rows.unit_convention_risk: Natural units, Planck units, SI units, code units, simulator units, catalog units, and metadata units can make dimensional constants look fundamental or hide scale-setting choices.
unit_convention_rows.residual_gap: A dimensionally consistent or unit-invariant expression can still fail physical recovery, constant recovery, metrological traceability, observed-sector recovery, and candidate-native identifiability.
unit_convention_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer candidate identity, scale recovery, constant prediction, or ToE support from natural units, dimensional consistency, unit conversion, or code-unit convention alone.

unit_convention_rows.unit_convention_class: metadata/provenance wrapper; not a physical unit convention
unit_convention_rows.unit_or_dimension_object: Archive package units, manifest labels, generated-summary counts, JSON field names, and metadata conventions.
unit_convention_rows.dimensional_invariance_test: Metadata conventions must be stable enough for replay and audit, but they are not physical unit choices or candidate-native dimensional structure.
unit_convention_rows.unit_convention_risk: Clean package metadata can make labels look standardized without adding physical unit or dimensional evidence.
unit_convention_rows.residual_gap: Metadata improves custody and restart; it does not create physical unit, dimensional-analysis, or scale-setting support.
unit_convention_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer physical units, dimensional recovery, scale-setting, or candidate identity from metadata/provenance alone.
